Ticket leases from tickets.acquire are still held for core, claude, live-snapshot. Idea tickets filed this session: 261106-bug-git-merge-directory-rename-relocates-tickets, 261106-bug-claude-mod-startup-config-get-permission-flood.

Next on resume: (1) Start W2: core P3 (index + session page; mockup reference ai-docs/ref/whiteboard-mockup/r4-dashboard (tracked since 5aa8b1fac); consume the snapshot schema above) and claude P2 (Claude mod feeds dashboard.intake). Worktree mode, one impl branch per ticket via git.resolve_impl_branch, auto-merge on [ok] reports (user delegated merges for the old session; re-confirm in a new session). (2) Lead hand checks: live Pi session + running daemon -> inspect snapshot.json and ring/ (before core P3); after core P3: two sessions in two projects in one daemon (dashboard.log 'session <reply-id> added'), detached daemon survives host exit, two concurrent ws-mcp leave one daemon. Dev builds all report 0.48.10-dev, so stop a running dev daemon (POST /shutdown with the endpoint.json token) before testing a rebuilt one. (3) Open minors: Windows StageExecutable prune race; Ensure outcome label after 2 spawns; panel-only writes missing from the session fingerprint (core P3 widens); rich-items markdown link inside an inline option button; live-snapshot: evicted agent revived as running by a status-less event, tool names/agent ids/mail titles not scrubbed for session keys, failed grandchild shows done, leftover mail mark tags next origin-less turn, timed-out-but-landed intake call duplicated after resync; Pi bridge.test.ts 65-tool contract check stale (runtime lists 69).
